title: Review round 2: Build mime-tree and smime-tree workspace
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Five actionable findings. The two highest-impact items are: (1) preferred_digest_algorithm/supported_key_enc_algorithm are dead API surface that promises extensibility the library does not honour — must be either wired up or removed before 1.0; (2) RecipientIdentifier lacks implementor guidance, setting up silent match failures. The cert-chain error messages and missing CHANGELOG are operational pain points but not correctness risks. ParseError::InvalidRange Display is clear and needs no action.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. All ten changed files reviewed in full. The encrypt/decrypt KARI asymmetry (encrypt produces KARI output; decrypt silently skips it) is functionally a known limitation documented in decrypt.rs but worth flagging to whoever closes the KARI decrypt issue. The rsa:: prefix on ECDSA verify calls (verify.rs and cert.rs) is a genuine readability trap but not a correctness issue — the trait is satisfied by p256/p384 VerifyingKey. The unreachable AES-192-KW arm in ecdh_wrap_cek is dead code but not harmful. No cryptographic protocol violations found. No lifetime or memory safety issues (no unsafe). The per-signer capture pattern is correct for multi-signer CMS. The u32 range encoding decision is sound.
